description: This file defines the ConnectionFailedException class, an immutable runtime exception thrown when a network connection attempt fails. It includes methods for creating instances with custom messages, headers, and deserialization from JSON.

classes.name: ConnectionFailedException
classes.description: An exception indicating failure to establish a network connection, identified by a specific error code, with methods for construction and JSON deserialization.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for constructing instances with a specific ConnectionId.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Deprecated method for creating an exception with a custom message, description, and headers.

methods.description: Constructs an exception with a specific message, description, and headers.

methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.
